title: The polynomial ring over a normal domain is a normal domain
statement: Let $R$ be a normal domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], i.e. an integral domain that is integrally closed in its field of fractions, and let $R[X]$ be the polynomial ring in one variable $X$ over $R$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. Then $R[X]$ is a normal domain: it is an integral domain, and every element of its field of fractions that is a root of a monic polynomial with coefficients in $R[X]$ lies in $R[X]$.
